reading: Six Zeros in two sections of three
basis: Six at the fight in every account, including Yanagiya's own.

title: The Bettys' height
reading: 6,500 ft in cruise, 4,500 ft at the sighting
basis: Wikipedia's cruise height and the report's height when sighted, the escort 1,500 ft above in both.
